title: Lenskart Case Study 👓 How Trust Built a ₹80000 Crore Eyewear Brand | Peyush Bansal | Live Hindi
description:
This video is about "Lenskart Case Study: How Trust Built a ₹80000 Crore Eyewear Brand | Peyush Bansal | Live Hindi"

In this detailed Lenskart case study, we explore the Lenskart success story and break down how Lenskart became successful in a highly unorganised and trust-deficit market. This video explains the Lenskart business model, its marketing strategy, and how the brand focused on building trust to completely transform the eyewear industry in India.

India’s eyewear market was dominated by local optical shops with limited choice, inconsistent pricing, and poor customer experience. This case study explains how Lenskart changed the eyewear market by combining technology, scale, and an omnichannel retail model. From online eye tests to offline experience stores, Lenskart created a seamless journey that helped it outperform local optical shops and become a leader among D2C brands in India.

We also analyse Lenskart vs local optical shops, its rapid expansion, and why brand trust became Lenskart’s biggest competitive advantage. This Indian startup case study highlights key lessons for entrepreneurs, retailers, and business students on market creation, execution, and long-term growth.

If you want to understand the real strategy behind Lenskart’s growth, this video explains the Lenskart strategy in detail and why it is considered one of the most impactful startup success stories in India.
